title: A Codex foreground focused Node run leaves no host trace at all: no execution start or end observation, no verification record (not even Unknown), no refusal notice
outcome: Every foreground launcher run a session makes in its named root ends with exactly one host outcome on the bound item: a verification record (PASS, FAIL or Unknown with a named guard), or a refusal or non-recognition notice naming why. A run never leaves no trace.
acceptance: The holder's note identifies, from host state or logs with source locators, why run test-632de02f produced no observation, record or notice (for example: the Codex exec completion was never observed, the command form was not recognized and the non-recognition notice was not sent, or the record was dropped).
A regression test drives that cause and shows the host then emits exactly one outcome (a record or a named refusal or notice) for the run.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact committed tree.

completion.summary: Implemented the foreground launcher outcome handling and regression coverage. The independent acceptance evaluation 120dd0653abc4eccb6118eb24ca49d53 passed all three criteria at the landed source revision; the full five-stage gate passed on the exact tree.
